summary: Defines a MIME content type for holding directory information, such as the details of people or organizations. It gives a general text format that profiles like vCard build on. It is a proposed standard that was replaced by RFC 6350.

eli5.summary: It is a standard way to write contact information so any program can read it, like a neat card file that all programs agree on.

questions: what is the mime directory content type
what format does vcard build on
